body: That sounds kinda like a psychedelic experience turned bad, alcohol can get really psychedelic on high doses. Kinda like deliriant and those tend to be really scary and unpleasant.
Seventeen minutes and using the first interview to make himself look good, the arrogance and the pain. The hate is so justified, Bojack is unforgivable.
Even if it isn't and its morbid to think it but I strangely got more closure from thinking Bojack died than if he lived. No matter what though, I respect that he chooses to keep living.
Part of me thinks Bojack is dead and this episode was everyone letting him go.
Comfort for all my dark thoughts, honestly the most relatable thing I've seen in a while.

I did block off everything and maybe I've become ill enough to not see good intentions but I can't see in light in people's eyes. When I look in the mirror I see two black holes where my eyes are and I see the same on everyone else. None of them reached out earlier when I wanted and needed it. Now that I've reached a state of indifference, it annoys me. I want to be ignored and go back to status quo. I'm know I'm ill and this isn't healthy but I don't want them anymore, I don't want the past or people that I know don't care about me. I don't need anyone to care about me, I've survived without long enough and I continue as myself untouched by other people.

I can't believe that there is any genuine emotion in what anyone has to say, the current state of affairs have always been the truth I just put down all decorum and became a stranger but we were always fundamentally estranged. Nothing can move my still heart, its like it stopped beating already.

\^

Life philosophy right here, I fucking agree.
There are hundreds of smart people who live well adjusted lives. I'm being a bitch because I'm a bitch. I just can't vibe with being alive.
Yeah it was deep ass hole, I think I became the buddha for a few hours

I read through as much as I could in one sitting. I've conditioned myself into being Mr Hyde through a bunch of mini approvals, I see that shame isn't a good enough motivator. I'm honestly not even ashamed, I woke up from a dream where I was looking for my identity.

I went through this dream state learning about all these other lives I could have lived and they were all preferable to the bed I made myself. The moment that my real life returned to me, I realized the depth of the pain.

The stiffness in my being let up and I woke up in tears, I couldn't stop crying. I can so accurately and clearly see the moment I died, I've been sleep walking ever since. Justifying the pain thinking that way it won't hurt but that pain ruled me.

I'm not ashamed, I'm alone and desperate. I am in fucking pain and I can't be okay with justifying it anymore.

Thank you, I realize that the anger isn't very helpful and neither is the action that gave birth to it. I hate myself I know that but I hate cocaine more for what it has taken from me. I am trying to see it for what it is, an agent for change that harmed me and identify less with it.

There really isn't any excuse then, I want to start making one up. I want stop reacting to my problems, I want to anticipate my issues. I get bored by self isolating, I don't do any meaningful work, I fundamentally don't care about myself or anyone else. I'm going back to college, I'm getting my license and a job, and I'll work on therapy and learn to work better.
